text_block_list.text:
I reached my limit... The race is over...
but I'm still
out of breath...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: I gotta say, though, the way Taishin was running out there was wild!
text_block_list.name: Fan B

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that intensity! It makes you want
to root
for her even more!
text_block_list.name: Fan C

text_block_list.text:
I won, but that really did me in... I'm
kinda
surprised I got first...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Yeah... but Taishin's energy today was, like, wow... It was really, really intense...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: It makes me wanna work harder!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you pick my next race yet? I
wanna run a
big one!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Although Уиннинг Тикит is exhausted,
there's no
denying she got a great result
in today's race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
So for our next challenge, I think we
should aim
for the big race that tops off
the first half of the
Twinkle Series year...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Whoa! A Grand Prix race! I bet a lot of
BIG
competitors will show up there!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
What if Taishin and Hayahide enter too,
and it
becomes a super hot match like
the Derby?!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: All the cheers! All the smiles! Just thinking about it makes me wanna... cryyyy!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
All right! I'm gonna go full blast for the

Takarazuka Kinen!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит
